offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment for homes, commercial buildings and food retailers. Sells mainly through independent contractors and distributors, plus company-owned stores.

primary_products.value: residential furnaces; air conditioners and heat pumps; commercial rooftop units; commercial refrigeration equipment; replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC contractors, distributors, commercial building owners, food retailers; B2C: homeowners buying heating and cooling systems through dealers

end_markets.value: residential construction; commercial construction; food retail; refrigerated transport; building maintenance

revenue_model.value: product sales: heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment, parts and accessories sold to contractors and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds equipment, sold to contractors, distributors and commercial customers; distributor: company-owned stores sell equipment and parts to contractors and homeowners

geography_served.value: global: primarily United States, also Canada, Mexico, Europe, Australia and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: residential heating and cooling, commercial heating and cooling, and commercial refrigeration

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent HVAC contractors and wholesale distributors; own locations: company-owned Lennox stores selling to contractors and homeowners; direct sales: national accounts and large commercial customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: DOE efficiency standards, EPA refrigerant rules, and UL and other product safety standards
